how.title: Three steps to the right moment
how.s1Text: Exactly your stay: hotel, check-in, check-out and guests.
how.s2Text: On the big booking sites and directly with the hotel. After 7 days you'll see whether the price is low right now.
how.s3Text: We show you where it's cheapest. Soon also by email when the price drops.

checkout.title: The cheapest price isn't always the real one
checkout.text: Some sites show less in search than you pay at checkout. We test sites up to the last page before payment and compare. Sites that often end up pricier get a low price accuracy score and rank lower.
checkout.receiptNote: Example. We show real results per site as price accuracy.

cta.title: Find the right moment for your hotel.
cta.text: Free, no account and no cookies. We only earn when you book through a partner link. Your price stays the same.

stay.noDataTitle: No prices for this stay yet
stay.noDataText: We check it every morning. As soon as a provider reports a price, you'll see it here. From the 7th day with a price we tell you whether the price is low right now.
stay.untrackedTitle: We don't track these dates yet
stay.untrackedText: Every morning we check fixed dates at this hotel: weekends and selected weekdays. Soon you can have your own dates tracked too.
stay.pastTitle: This stay is in the past
stay.pastText: Pick new dates to see the current prices.
stay.inactiveTitle: We're not tracking this hotel right now
stay.inactiveText: That's why there are no new prices here. The home page lists every hotel we check each morning.
stay.unavailableText: We couldn't load the data for this stay. Please try again in a few minutes.
stay.methodText: Every morning we ask Google Hotels for the total price of exactly this stay, across every provider we've checked. We compare the cheapest price with the last 60 days. It's not a forecast: prices can rise or fall at any time.
